Plasminogen (BAN) Plasminógeno. CAS — 9001-91-6. Profile Plasminogen is the specific substance derived from plasma which, when activated to plasmin, has the property of lysing fi- brinogen, fibrin, and some other proteins. Its role in the control of haemostasis is described further on p.1045. Plasminogen has been investigated as a thrombolytic and has been used with other blood products in wound-sealant preparations.
